messages:
samir: Heads up 1: I booked a trip Sep 1-5 for a family wedding. I still have 2 floating holidays left and 4 vacation days. Will year-end carryover affect my ability to use them in December if I use them now?

elaine: You can use them now as normal. Carryover only matters at year-end cutoff. If you take them now they deduct from current balance. If you plan to save them for December we recommend waiting but no rule forces you to hold them.

people-ops: FYI carryover reminder: Unused vacation days above the carryover cap (2 days for FY2026) will be forfeited at the Jan 10 cutoff unless you submit an exception. Floating holidays do not count toward the carryover cap. Exceptions considered for medical or relocation.

samir: Clarify: floating holidays not counted toward cap? Good to know. Also what's the process to request a carryover exception if I need one later?

people-ops: Submit a Carryover Exception request via the HR portal with supporting docs. People Ops reviews and escalates to finance for approval. Note: approvals are rare and typically for documented medical or business travel that prevented use.

hr-bot: Reminder: Carryover cutoff for FY2026: 2027-01-10 11:59pm PT. Auto-forfeit occurs after this timestamp.
